competing_explanation: The policy may have changed, use a different return window, or distinguish standard items from other categories, making the 30-day claim outdated or misapplied.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items.
refutation_criterion: Evidence shows the current standard-item full-refund window is not 30 days, or that the 30-day window applies only to non-standard items, expired policies, or special conditions.
